function: Estimation of the cascaded BS-RIS-user channel from uplink pilots in hybrid near-field and far-field propagation, by unrolled convolutional dictionary learning networks (pp. 1, 5-9).
system: Passive reflecting XL-RIS, 64x8 UPA (512 elements), BS ULA with 32 antennas, single-antenna user, TDD, mmWave 10 GHz carrier (pp. 3, 9).
method: Unrolled ISTA networks with learnable convolutional dictionaries: CISTA-Net (self-supervised), CISTA-Net+ (supervised), and CNN-CDL with CNN gradient blocks and learned proximal module; end-to-end training (pp. 6-9).
data_channel: Custom simulation: Saleh-Valenzuela BS-RIS link; RIS-user link with 3 far-field and 3 near-field paths, random gains, angles, scatterers; no 3GPP or measured data (pp. 4, 9).
test_conditions: Same simulated setup for training and testing, SNR -5 to 10 dB, 64-256 pilots; one run trains only on [3,3] far/near path split, tests on other splits (pp. 10-11).
baselines: Non-learned: OMP with predefined dictionary, oracle least squares upper bound. Learned: ISTA-Net+ [47] (unrolled ISTA network) (p. 9).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR, pilots, path configuration and unrolled layers; spectral efficiency versus transmit power; FLOPs and dictionary size (pp. 10-12).
complexity: FLOPs by fvcore (x10^9): CNN-CDL 25.42, CISTA-Net+ 0.54, CISTA-Net 0.54, ISTA-Net+ 8.47, OMP 0.51; dictionary parameters listed (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 4: "described using the Saleh-Valenzuela (SV) model [32]"; p. 9: "randomly generated from a complex Gaussian distribution"; custom simulator, no 3GPP model or measured data
q2_support: p. 11: "training only on the [3,3] configuration and testing on others"
q3_support: p. 9: "OMP: orthogonal matching pursuit method using a predefined dictionary from [12]"; p. 9: "ISTA-Net+: an unrolled network architecture based on the ISTA [47]"; p. 10: "consistently outperforms OMP across all SNR levels"
q4_support: p. 10: "Table I summarizes the FLOPs and dictionary sizes for each method"
q5_support: p. 10: "The package is available at: https://github.com/facebookresearch/fvcore" is a third-party FLOP counter, not the paper's code; p. 9: "randomly generated from a complex Gaussian distribution", so the channels are simulated and no data link is given
notes: PDF is the arXiv version (2409.16664v1) of the CNN-CDL paper; it prints no DOI, so the DOI match rests on the title. Area 2 because the learned networks estimate the cascaded channel, and the RIS is passive. Training set size, epochs and training SNR are not stated. q3 learned baseline is ISTA-Net+ [47], an external architecture that the paper applies to this problem; its own CISTA-Net variants are not counted. Table I (p. 10) was read from the page image.
